description: This Java class 'PackingServices' provides service methods for managing packing operations within an order shipment process, including adding, updating, clearing, and completing packing lines and sessions, as well as calculating shipping charges.

classes.name: PackingServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for managing packing operations in shipment processing.

methods.name: addPackLine
methods.description: Adds or increases a line item in the packing session with specified product, quantity, weight, and instructions.

methods.name: packBulk
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple packing lines based on bulk input data, handling multiple packages, quantities, and weights.

methods.name: incrementPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the next available package sequence number from the packing session.

methods.name: clearLastPackage
methods.description: Clears the last package in the packing session and returns the next package sequence number.

methods.name: clearPackLine
methods.description: Removes a specific packing line identified by order, item, shipment, product, inventory, and package IDs.

methods.name: clearPackAll
methods.description: Clears all packing lines in the current packing session.

methods.name: calcPackSessionAdditionalShippingCharge
methods.description: Calculates and sets additional shipping charges based on package weights and shipping details.

methods.name: completePack
methods.description: Finalizes the packing session, setting instructions, charges, and box types, and completes the shipment process.

methods.name: setSessionPackageWeights
methods.description: Sets weights for each package in the session and calculates total shippable weight.

methods.name: setSessionShipmentBoxTypes
methods.description: Assigns box types to packages within the packing session.
